application_status.label: Applications available by residential jurisdiction
application_status.detail: Canadian applicants must currently reside in Canada. Application method and exact document handling vary by the Japanese mission responsible for the applicant's residential address.

change_control.review_note: Canadian baseline verified against the Embassy of Japan in Canada plus current Ottawa, Toronto and Vancouver Working Holiday guidance.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you a Canadian citizen?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: This Canadian Working Holiday route is for Canadian citizens.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you currently residing in Canada?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Canadian applicants must currently reside in Canada.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Canadian Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Working Holiday programme is not intended for applicants whose main purpose is employment.

eligibility_rules.label: Do you hold a valid Canadian passport?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: A valid Canadian passport is required.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the programme's good-health and no-criminal-record requirements?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Canadian programme requires good health and no criminal record.

funds_rule.input_label: Funds shown in your Canadian bank statement (C$)
funds_rule.guidance_note: Exact proof-of-funds handling is mission-specific. Ottawa and Toronto currently state a C$3,500 minimum for a single applicant plus additional reasonable travel funds when tickets are not provided.

jurisdiction.label: Japanese mission responsible for your Canadian residence
jurisdiction.description: Visa matters are handled locally according to Canadian residential address.
jurisdiction.ui_help: Choose the region matching your Canadian residence. Some missions have different submission methods or financial-document details.

options.label: Ottawa region
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in Canada — Ottawa
options.mission_detail: Ottawa-region Working Holiday applications are handled by the Embassy. Current Ottawa guidance allows in-person applications and says mail may be considered after consultation.

funds_rule.no_ticket_note: Ottawa requires at least C$3,500 for a single applicant; if tickets are not provided, add reasonable travel expenses above that amount.

options.label: Ontario (except Ottawa region)
options.mission_detail: Toronto handles Ontario residents outside the Ottawa region. Current guidance requires advance contact/appointment and allows mail only in some circumstances after consultation.

funds_rule.no_ticket_note: Toronto requires at least C$3,500 for a single applicant; if tickets are not provided, add reasonable travel expenses above that amount.

options.label: British Columbia or Yukon
options.mission_detail: Vancouver handles British Columbia and Yukon residents. Check its current Working Holiday checklist for the exact financial-document amount and submission method.

options.label: Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, NWT or Nunavut
options.mission_detail: Calgary handles Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Northwest Territories and Nunavut. Confirm its current checklist before applying.

options.label: Quebec, New Brunswick, PEI, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador
options.mission_detail: Montreal handles Quebec, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland and Labrador. Confirm its current local submission instructions.

options.label: I currently reside outside Canada
options.mission_label: Canadian Working Holiday route may not apply
options.mission_detail: Current Canadian Working Holiday guidance requires applicants to reside in Canada.
options.issue: The Canadian Working Holiday route requires the applicant to be currently residing in Canada.

document_checklist.title: Valid Canadian passport
document_checklist.description: Provide a valid Canadian passport following the responsible mission's original/copy instructions.

document_checklist.title: Completed visa application form and recent photo
document_checklist.description: Complete the current visa form and provide the photograph required by your mission.

document_checklist.title: Resume / CV
document_checklist.description: Prepare the current personal resume/CV requested for the Working Holiday application.

document_checklist.title: Detailed itinerary
document_checklist.description: Prepare a detailed intended-activities plan covering your proposed stay.

document_checklist.title: Reason-for-application letter
document_checklist.description: Explain your reason for applying for a Working Holiday visa.

document_checklist.title: Bank statement / proof of funds
document_checklist.description: Use the amount and document format required by the mission handling your residential jurisdiction.

document_checklist.title: Travel ticket or itinerary
document_checklist.description: Provide the travel evidence requested by your mission; extra funds may be required when tickets are not provided.

document_checklist.title: Doctor's note
document_checklist.description: Current Ottawa and Toronto guidance requests a physician's note stating you are in good health to travel abroad.

preparation_checklist.title: Read the current Canadian official guidance
preparation_checklist.description: Re-open the Embassy Working Holiday overview and your local Japanese mission's current checklist.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm your residential jurisdiction
preparation_checklist.description: Visa handling differs by Canadian region; use the mission responsible for where you live.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm your mission's exact funds rule
preparation_checklist.description: Do not assume Ottawa/Toronto amounts apply unchanged at every Canadian mission.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final source check
preparation_checklist.description: Application methods and appointments can change; verify immediately before lodging.
